![](../images/scribbles-mug-1.jpg){group="scribbles-mug" fig-alt="front view - scribbles mug"}

This was my first time making colored clay, actually wedging pigments into the clay. I craaaave this deep penetrating color rather than just a layer of color on the surface. Why?  Maybe because I'm often torn between wanting the touch and feel of exposed clay and wanting color. This way I don't have to choose. Colored clay also offers different opportunities for surface design. I love being able to doodle with a pencil, very different and casual.
